6292.meaning1: independent of others; not relying on another
6292.construction:
na > a + para + paccaya + ā
aparapaccaya + ā
6292.commentary: (SNa) tasmiṃ aparapaccayā'ti tasmiṃ ariyaphale, na aññaṃ pattiyāyanti, paccakkhato'va paṭivijjhitvā ṭhitā.

examples.text: dukkham'eva uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatī'ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati aparapaccayā

6293.commentary: (DNa) aparapajā c'assa paṭipūjentī'ti sahāyassa puttadhītaro pajā nāma, tesaṃ pana puttadhītaro ca nattupanattakā ca aparapajā nāma. te paṭipūjenti keḷāyanti mam'āyan'ti maṅgalakāl'ādīsu tesaṃ maṅgal'ādīni karonti. (DNt) aparā pacchimā pajā aparapajā, apar'āparaṃ uppannā vā pajā aparapajā.

examples.text: imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtena uttarā disā mitt'āmaccā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampan'ti, pamattaṃ rakkhanti, pamattassa sāpateyyaṃ rakkhanti, bhītassa saraṇaṃ honti, āpadāsu na vijahanti, aparapajā c'assa paṭipūjenti.
